title: Page 3
content_zh:
该不会是……

“唔—”突如其来的头疼，令她两手紧紧抱着脑袋，脑海里闪过一幕幕画面，那些片段交错的浮现在她眼前。

见她神色痛苦，路挽风吃了一惊，上前关切的询问，“姑娘，你怎么了？”他担心她一个不小心会栽进江里，抬手轻扶着她的肩。

待那头疼渐渐止息，寒招财深吸几口气，理清思绪后，她抬手抹了抹自个儿的脸。适才她接收了这具身躯里残留的一些记忆。

这身子的原主儿叫娄竹心，死在先前那场绞痛里，而后，她的魂魄不知怎地被吸引进这副身躯里。

在娄竹心死去的时候，她刚巧也出了意外，那时她正端着一碗补药要送去给大哥……

娘想让大哥、二哥考功名，因此自小就送他们入族学去读书。

不像自小调皮坐不住的二哥，大哥书读得极好，两年前才十六岁时，已考上秀才，夫子认为今年的乡试，大哥有机会能考上举人，娘很高兴，每夜都熬补药给大哥吃。

她端着补药经过二哥房前，那时二哥刚巧从屋里跑出来，撞上了她……然后，再醒来时她就在船上了。

昨夜她一直想不起来这事，随着她接收娄竹心一部分的记忆，才忆起。

寒招财忽然蹙起柳眉，她该不会是被二哥一撞给撞死了吧？所以她的魂魄才会跑到这娄竹心身上来。

若是如此，那向来疼爱她的爹娘还有大哥、二哥还不伤心死，尤其是撞死她的二哥，岂不要自责死。

不成，她得回去一趟，告诉他们她没死，只是换了个壳子，而且这身子的脸比她原来那副还美上几分呢，这也算是因祸得福吧。

正这般想着，她耳畔忽然传来一道嗓音！

“我想起来了。”

她闻声下意识的抬首望过去，下一瞬，就听见对方接着说：“你是娄家的四姑娘。”

寒招财这才瞧清路挽风的长相，这人眉如墨染，鼻如悬胆，倒是生得一表人才，但那神色却十分冷峻。

“想不到这么巧，娄姑娘竟与我搭了同一艘客船。”

寒招财没想到他竟会认得这身子的原主，一时之间犹豫着要不要否认，她打算要回自个儿的家去，如今被他认出来，万一原主的家人找来，可就麻烦了。

下一瞬，有段记忆一掠而过，她讪讪的从他身上收回眼神。

娄竹心的父母曾经想将她许配给眼前这叫路挽风的人为妻，可没想到人家瞧不上她这个庶女，拒绝了。

暗暗倾慕他的娄竹心，为此黯然神伤许久。直到数日前因着外祖母生辰，娄家的几个男人都有事，娄竹心上头三个姊姊又都已出嫁，她嫡母便支使她携了礼，去江扬城替外祖母祝寿。

回程时，她们主仆一行六人搭上那艘翻覆的客船，如今那同行的三名家丁和那伺候娄竹心的婆子和丫头也不知是死是活。

见他在认出娄竹心的身分后，脸色便有些冷淡，约莫是也想起去年拒绝与她结亲的事，且听他适才那话，好似怀疑她是刻意与他搭乘同艘客船，寒招财心里有气慢条斯理的酸他几句，“若是我早知你在那船上，我就不搭那船了；但若非我搭了那船，这会儿你只怕是见不到今天的太阳。”

“娄姑娘的救命之恩，路某自是不会忘记，此前我倒是未曾听说娄姑娘会凫水。”听见她话里透着抹嘲讽，路挽风登时明白自己想岔了。他是为了要赶回苏云城，才临时决定搭上那艘翻覆的客船，她自是不可能事先得知。

他是去年陪着祖母去城外问心观拜神，偶然间在那里遇见陪着嫡母去的娄竹心，两人因此有过一面之缘，不久，娄家便使人来说亲，有意想将娄竹心许配给他。

路家与寒家虽都是商户，但他们两家往来不多，他们路家自百年前便是官宦之家，先后出过不少三品以上的大官，不过在曾祖父那一代，因遭了牵连，路家在朝为官的几人全被罢黜。

隔了约莫十年之后，路家终于有一人被起复，因着路家人为官一向清廉，一大家子的男人又都是手不能扛、肩不能挑的书生，这十年间，日子竟过得捉襟见肘，最后沦落到变卖祖产的地步。

曾祖父为防再发生此类事情，订下规矩，此后只有大房、二房的子弟需进学考功名，三房则行商。

他祖父便是曾祖父的第三子，故而从那以后他们三房便开始经商，经过祖孙三代的经营，如今路家三房已是富甲一方。

而娄家却是靠着将女儿嫁给那些官宦人家为妾，或是做填房，借此与那些官员攀上关系。

也不只是娄家如此，其他商户也有不少人这般行事，不过他对这种依靠家中女子来攀权附贵的事有些瞧不上，故而在娄家提出有意与他结亲时，便一口回绝。

寒招财轻描淡写回他一句，“我会什么，难道还得差人告诉你不成？”

回头瞥见江面上自己披头散发的模样，她用五指细细将那一头黑绸般的长发仔细梳理好，簪子、发钗全都掉进水里，她随手折了根细藤蔓暂时先扎起来，绑在脑后。

路挽风用不着看，知晓自己多半也一头乱发，原先束在发髻上的玉环早不知遗落在哪里，他学着她用五指梳理过后，同样去折了根藤蔓，随意扎起来。

“娄姑娘，咱们找路离开吧。”怎么说也算是相识一场，她又是自个儿的救命恩人，他不好丢下她先走。

寒招财瞅了眼初升的朝阳，和湛蓝的晴空，有感而发道：“雨过天青，真难以想像昨天曾下过那样一场惊天动地的大雷雨，让一艘偌大的客船倾覆沉没，也不知道有多少人能逃出来……”

闻言，他想起那些随从也不知是生是死，但此时他落难在此，也无计可施。

“只希望大家都能像我们一般得救，走吧。”他此时饥肠辘辘，打算先去找些吃食来填饱肚子。

两人往林子那头走去，走了片刻，瞧见一株莲雾树，树上结实累累，抬手便可摘到，路挽风正饿着，伸手摘下一颗，只吃一口，便酸得倒牙，他连忙吐掉。

在一旁看到的寒招财噗哧笑出声，抬眼朝树上瞅了瞅，摘了颗莲雾，送进嘴里，吃得眉开眼笑，嘴里一边说：“真甜。”

见她说甜，路挽风面露怀疑的看着她。

寒招财笑得弯起嘴角，“你不信呀，没骗你，我这颗真的很甜。”说完，她再吃了几口，脸上露出满足的笑靥。

路挽风瞥了眼手上那颗咬了一口的莲雾，仍是不太相信她的话。

寒招财很快吃完，踮起脚，再摘来两颗，见他盯着她看，她笑咪咪将其中一颗递给他，随口揶揄他道：“想不到堂堂路家大少爷竟然不懂要怎么挑莲雾吃，喏，给你，别再犯傻了，不摘这些成熟的果子，偏要摘那还未熟的，当然酸啦。”

被她这般嘲讽，路挽风心中虽有几分不悦，但仍是接过那颗莲雾，与先前自己摘的那颗比了比，发现她摘的莲雾果脐已完全展开，而他摘的还密合未开。

他半信半疑的咬一口她摘的那颗，入口甘甜的滋味，令他忍不住一口接一口，很快便吃完一颗。

接着他抬目望向垂挂在树上的那些果实，只挑那些果脐已展开的摘，果然都没再吃到酸涩的，一连吃了七、八个，才稍稍止了腹中的饥饿。

回头，瞧见寒招财吃完后，再摘来几颗抱在怀里，沿着林子，未着鞋袜的一双莲足从容的往外走去。
content_en:
Could it be...

"Well -" A sudden headache caused her to hold her head tightly with both hands. Scenes flashed through her mind, and those fragments appeared intertwined in front of her eyes.

Seeing her expression of pain, Lu Wanfeng was startled and stepped forward to ask with concern, "Girl, what's wrong with you?" He was worried that she would fall into the river accidentally, so he raised his hand to gently support her shoulders.

When the headache gradually subsided, Han Zhaocai took a few deep breaths and cleared her thoughts, then she raised her hand and wiped her face.Just now she accepted some of the memories left in this body.

The original owner of this body was Lou Zhuxin, who died from colic in the previous episode, and then, her soul was somehow attracted into this body.

When Lou Zhuxin died, she happened to have an accident. At that time, she was carrying a bowl of tonics to send to her elder brother...

My mother wanted my eldest brother and second brother to take the exams for merit and fame, so she sent them to study at a clan school since they were young.

Unlike the second brother, who had been naughty and restless since childhood, the eldest brother was very good at reading. He was admitted as a scholar two years ago when he was only sixteen years old. The master thought that in this year's provincial examination, the eldest brother would have a chance to pass the examination. My mother was very happy and made up tonics for him every night.

She was passing by her second brother's house carrying the tonic, and at that time, his second brother happened to run out of the house and bump into her... Then, when she woke up, she was on the boat.

She couldn't remember it last night. She only remembered it as she absorbed part of Lou Zhuxin's memory.

Han Zhaocai suddenly frowned. Could it be that she was hit and killed by her second brother?That's why her soul came to Lou Zhuxin.

If this is the case, then her parents, her eldest brother, and her second brother, who have always loved her, are not sad to death, especially the second brother who killed her. Why don't they blame themselves to death?

No, she had to go back and tell them that she was not dead, but had just changed her shell, and her face in this body was much prettier than her original one. This could be considered a blessing in disguise.

Just as she was thinking this, a voice suddenly came from her ears!

"I remembered."

When she heard the sound, she subconsciously raised her head and looked over. The next moment, she heard the other party say: "You are the fourth girl of the Lou family."

Only then did Han Zhaocai take a look at Lu Wanfeng's appearance. This man's eyebrows were stained with ink and his nose was like hanging gallbladder. He seemed to be a talented person, but his expression was very cold.

"Unexpectedly, by such a coincidence, Miss Lou and I boarded the same passenger ship."

Han Zhaocai didn't expect that he would recognize the original owner of this body. He hesitated for a moment whether to deny it. She planned to go back to her home. Now that she was recognized by him, it would be troublesome if the original owner's family came to find her.

The next moment, a memory flashed past, and she looked away from him with a smile.

Lou Zhuxin's parents once wanted to marry her to the man named Lu Wanfeng, but they didn't expect that they looked down on her as a concubine and refused.

Lou Zhuxin, who secretly admired him, felt sad for a long time.Until a few days ago, due to her grandmother's birthday, several men in the Lou family were busy, and Lou Zhuxin's three sisters were all married. Her aunt sent her to bring gifts and go to Jiangyang City to celebrate her grandmother's birthday.

On the way back, six of their masters and servants boarded the overturned passenger ship. Now the three servants who were traveling with them and the woman and girl who served Lou Zhuxin did not know whether they were dead or alive.

Seeing that his face became a little cold after recognizing Lou Zhuxin's identity, he probably also remembered his refusal to marry her last year. Listening to his words just now, it seemed that he suspected that she was deliberately taking the same passenger ship with him. Han Zhaocai was angry and said a few words to him slowly and calmly, "If I had known you were on that ship, I would not have taken that ship; but if I had not taken that ship, I'm afraid you wouldn't be able to see the sun today."

"Lu will never forget Miss Lou's life-saving grace. I have never heard that Miss Lou can drink water before." Hearing the sarcasm in her words, Lu Wanfeng immediately understood that he had gone astray.In order to rush back to Su Yuncheng, he made the temporary decision to board the capsized passenger ship. There was no way she could have known about it in advance.

Last year, he accompanied his grandmother to worship God at the Asking Heart Temple outside the city. By chance, he met Lou Zhuxin, who was accompanying his aunt's mother there. The two had a close relationship. Soon, the Lou family sent people to come to marry him, intending to betroth Lou Zhuxin to him.

Although the Lu family and the Han family are both merchants, they don't have much contact with each other. The Lu family has been a family of officials since a hundred years ago, and has produced many high-ranking officials above the third rank. However, in the great-grandfather's generation, all the officials in the Lu family were dismissed due to their involvement.

After about ten years, one member of the Lu family was finally resurrected. Because the Lu family had always been honest as officials, and the men in the family were all scholars who could not carry their hands or shoulders, during these ten years, life was extremely difficult, and they were finally reduced to selling off their ancestral property.

In order to prevent this kind of thing from happening again, my great-grandfather made a rule. From then on, only the children of the eldest and second eldest brothers had to go to school and take the exams for merit, while the third eldest brother went into business.

His grandfather was the third son of his great-grandfather, so from then on, the third family of the Lu family started doing business. After three generations of management, the third family of the Lu family was now very wealthy.

The Lou family, on the other hand, relied on marrying their daughters to those officials as concubines, or filling in houses, in order to build relationships with those officials.

It was not just the Lou family who was like this, many people in other merchants also acted like this. However, he looked down upon the idea of ​​relying on women in the family to gain power, so when the Lou family proposed to marry him, he refused.

Han Zhaocai replied lightly, "What do I know? Do I have to send someone to tell you?"

Looking back, she caught a glimpse of her disheveled hair on the river. She carefully combed her long black silk-like hair with her fingers. The hairpin and hairpin all fell into the water. She casually broke off a thin vine and tied it up temporarily, tying it behind her head.

Lu Wanfeng didn't need to look, he knew that most of his hair was messy, and the jade ring that was originally tied in the bun was long gone. After imitating her, he combed it with her five fingers, and then broke off a vine and tied it up at will.

"Miss Lou, let's find a way to leave." After all, it was an acquaintance, and she was his savior, so he couldn't leave her alone.

Han Zhaocai glanced at the rising sun and the clear blue sky, and said with emotion: "After the rain, the sky is blue. It's hard to imagine that there was such an earth-shattering thunderstorm yesterday, which caused a huge passenger ship to capsize and sink. I don't know how many people could escape..."

Hearing this, he remembered that those who followed him did not know whether they were alive or dead, but at this moment he was in trouble and there was nothing he could do.

"I just hope everyone can be saved like us. Let's go." He was very hungry at this time and planned to find some food to fill his stomach first.

The two walked toward the end of the forest. After walking for a while, they saw a lotus mist tree. There were many fruits on the tree, and you could pick it with your hands. Lu Wanfeng was hungry, so he reached out and picked one. After only one bite, it was so sore that his teeth dropped, so he hurriedly vomited it out.

Han Zhaocai, who was watching from the side, burst out laughing. He looked up at the tree, picked a lotus mist, and put it into his mouth. He smiled widely while eating, and said: "It's so sweet."

Seeing her sweet words, Lu Wanfeng looked at her suspiciously.

Han Zhaocai smiled and curled up the corners of his mouth, "Don't believe it, I didn't lie to you, this one is really sweet." After saying that, she took a few more bites, with a satisfied smile on her face.

Lu Wanfeng glanced at the bitten lotus mist in his hand, but still didn't quite believe her words.

Han Zhaocai finished eating quickly, stood up on tiptoes, and picked two more. Seeing him staring at her, she smiled and handed one of them to him, teasing him casually: "I didn't expect that the dignified young master of the Lu family didn't know how to pick the lotus mist to eat. Here, here you go, don't be stupid again. Instead of picking these ripe fruits, you pick the unripe ones. Of course they are sour."

Although Lu Wanfeng was a little unhappy at being ridiculed by her, he still took the lotus mist and compared it with the one he picked earlier. He found that the navel of the lotus mist she picked was fully unfolded, while the one he picked was still closed.

He dubiously took a bite of the one she picked. The sweet taste in his mouth made him unable to resist one bite after another, and he quickly finished one.

Then he looked up at the fruits hanging on the trees, picking only those with their navels spread out, and sure enough, he couldn't eat any more sour ones. He ate seven or eight in a row before he quenched his hunger a little.

Looking back, I saw that after Han Zhaocai finished eating, he picked a few more and held them in his arms. He walked calmly out along the forest with a pair of lotus feet without shoes and socks.
